{"candidates":[{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Projects and filters endpoints before paired-route aggregation, preserving the exact predicate, endpoint order, COUNT(*), NULL groups, duplicate multiplicity, and DuckDB types. No validation results are claimed.","sql":"WITH first_week_routes AS (
  SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff
  FROM trips
  WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7
)
SELECT pickup, dropoff, COUNT(*) AS trips
FROM first_week_routes
GROUP BY pickup, dropoff;"}]}
